Question 11
?

Which of the following is a stream function for the vector field F(x,y)=xcos⁡(xy)i−xsin⁡(xy)j?

a
ψ(x,y)=−xycos⁡(xy)−ysin⁡(xy)
b
ψ(x,y)=xcos⁡(xy)
c
ψ(x,y)=−xsin⁡(xy)
d
F has no stream function
e
ψ(x,y)=−cos⁡(xy)−xysin⁡(xy)
